value.rationale: The short-time operator norm is a natural regularity invariant for immediately compact analytic composition semigroups. The result shows its sharp dimension-independent dependence on the worst rotation/damping ratio, a beyond-all-algebraic-orders onset as rotation is introduced, and the complete quadratic lattice-phase structure at the next order in one coordinate. These quantify a genuine continuity boundary rather than a routine repackaging of a semigroup classification.
